name: Hide Current Page From Menu – Advanced
author: cradlean

sections.description: This plugin hides the current page menu item in WordPress menus, supporting nested menus, user roles, menu locations, and post types.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings under ‘Menu Settings’ in the WordPress admin.
sections.faq:
How do I configure the plugin?

Go to Settings → Menu Settings and choose which menu items, roles, or locations to exclude.

Does this plugin support custom post types?

Yes, menu items linked to custom post types are supported.

Will it break my theme?

No, the plugin only filters menu output safely using WordPress hooks.
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • Initial release.
  • Hides current page menu items with exclusions by role, menu, and items.
  • Added support for nested menus and ancestor cleanup.
  • Supports pages, posts, and custom post types.
